member.name: T:Phoenixml.Platform.Hosting.SingleInstanceCoordinator
member.summary: Ensures only one instance of the application is running at a time. On Windows a named pipe is used; on macOS and Linux a Unix domain socket is used. If the socket or pipe infrastructure is unavailable (sandboxed environment, privilege restriction), the coordinator logs the failure and returns so the application starts normally — a degraded-graceful fallback rather than a hard failure.
member.remarks: Integration tests for this class are deferred; socket/pipe behaviour is runtime-environment-dependent and not reliably testable in CI without platform-specific setup.
